name: ron-spanned-value
instr:
Please add an owned, span-annotated Value tree to RON in `/app` for configuration diagnostics and typed decoding. Don't add new crates.

Expose `ron::value::SpannedValue { pub span: ron::error::Span, pub value: ron::value::SpannedValueKind }`. Both types implement `Debug` and `Clone`. `SpannedValueKind` has variants `Bool(bool)`, `Char(char)`, `Number(ron::value::Number)`, `String(String)`, `Bytes(Vec<u8>)`, `Option(Option<Box<SpannedValue>>)`, `Unit`, `Seq(Vec<SpannedValue>)`, and `Map(Vec<(SpannedValue, SpannedValue)>)`.

Add inherent methods `ron::Options::from_str_spanned(&self, s: &str) -> ron::error::SpannedResult<ron::value::SpannedValue>`, `ron::value::SpannedValue::into_value(self) -> ron::Value`, and `ron::value::SpannedValue::into_rust<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(self) -> ron::error::SpannedResult<T>`. Implement `core::str::FromStr` for `SpannedValue` with `Err = ron::error::SpannedError`, using default Options.

Use ordinary Value semantics, retaining map entries in source order, including duplicates. Struct identifiers become String keys; their spans include any `r#`. Named units become Unit; tuples and named tuples become Seq. `into_value` recursively drops spans and applies Value's last-value-wins map semantics.

Spans are half-open, with 1-based lines and Unicode-scalar columns; each newline resets columns to 1. Include names, delimiters, suffixes and escape spelling; exclude surrounding whitespace, comments, separators and document attributes. Containers
